text: Cotton Blanket Throw with Fringe, 50 x 60" - Modern Moroccan Lattice Stone color/design by DII. I am guessing by the 5 star reviews and the one star reviews that this is sourced from multiple providers because the quality is so wildly different. I got a product from a vendor who should be dropped by DII before they damage DII reputation. scratchy, skimpy, poorly made. sad looking.

product_metadata.title: DII Modern Moroccan Cotton Blanket Throw with Fringe for Couch, Chair, Guest Room, Picnic, Camping, Beach, & Everyday Use, 50x60, French Blue
features: QUALITY IN THE DETAILS - Old-fashioned look with a modern twist with decorative fringe for the perfect finish that won't unravel in the wash
FITS THE RUSTIC, VINTAGE, OR DISTRESSED LOOK - This throw has a very chic and trendy look, throw over a couch or chair to add a splash of color and provide warmth on a cold night
VERSATILE - Use DII throw blankets to stay warm, as a decor piece, over a chair or couch, to wrap housewarming gifts, as a picnic blanket, when camping, and more
